title: In Grandfather's Day
mainIdea: Learning about the past helps us appreciate how life has changed over time.

pages.text: Sharr and Kaze visited their grandfather and asked him about life long ago.

question.text: Who is sharing stories about the past?

pages.text: Grandfather wanted to tell his grandchildren what life was like when he was young.

question.text: What did Grandfather want to do?

pages.text: The grandchildren were surprised to learn that people once used keyboards and drove cars.

question.text: What challenge did the grandchildren have?
options: They found it hard to imagine life in the past
They did not like the old technology Grandfather described

pages.text: Grandfather showed them pictures and shared stories about cooking meals and everyday life.

question.text: How did Grandfather help them understand?

pages.text: Sharr and Kaze were amazed by how different life used to be and appreciated Grandfather's stories.

options: The grandchildren appreciated learning about the past
They ignored Grandfather and asked to watch a movie instead
They left early because the old stories sounded too boring

elements.correct: To tell them how he lived when he was young
distractors: To teach them how to drive an old car

elements.correct: His grandchildren could not picture that world
distractors: His grandchildren disliked the old machines too
